```{r, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)

UBPR_2011_dollar = as.data.frame(read_csv("UBPR Balance Sheet dollar 2011.csv", show_col_types = F))
call_2011_1 = as.data.frame(read_csv("Call Report 2011(1 of 3).csv", show_col_types = F))
call_2011_2 = as.data.frame(read_csv("Call Report 2011(2 of 3).csv", show_col_types = F))
call_2011_3 = as.data.frame(read_csv("Call Report 2011(3 of 3).csv", show_col_types = F))

# Additional Datasets if needed
UBPR_2011_percent = as.data.frame(read_csv("UBPR Balance Sheet percent 2011.csv", show_col_types = F))

# Make sure we have consistent column names
colnames(UBPR_2011_dollar)[2] = "IDRSSD"
colnames(UBPR_2011_percent)[2] = "IDRSSD"

# Merge the datasets by the "IDRSSD" column
data1_dt <- as.data.table(UBPR_2011_dollar)
data2_dt <- as.data.table(call_2011_1)
data3_dt <- as.data.table(call_2011_2)
data4_dt <- as.data.table(call_2011_3)

merged_data_2011 <- data1_dt[data2_dt, on = "IDRSSD", allow.cartesian = TRUE
                        ][data3_dt, on = "IDRSSD", allow.cartesian = TRUE
                          ][data4_dt, on = "IDRSSD", allow.cartesian = TRUE]


# Extract the variables we want
column_names <- c("IDRSSD", "UBPR1410", "UBPRE116", "UBPRD665", "UBPR1590", "UBPRE117","UBPR3123",
                  "UBPR2123", "UBPRE119", "UBPRE118", "UBPR5369", "UBPRB528", "RCON2210",
                  "RCON6810", "RCON0352", "UBPRK426", "UBPR2366", "UBPRK434", "UBPRK437",
                  "UBPRD078", "UBPR2200", "UBPR2365", "UBPRE120", "UBPR8636", "UBPRD657",
                  "UBPRE121", "UBPR1754", "UBPRD662", "UBPRE122", "UBPRE123", "UBPR2170",
                  "UBPRG105", "UBPR3300")

# Index the specified columns
selected_columns <- merged_data_2011 %>% select(any_of(column_names))

# Non-existent variables
setdiff(column_names, colnames(selected_columns))
```
